evidence.summary: Linux-specific owned lifecycle control is documented, bounded and tested; assurance remains native MNCS.

reproduction.summary: Resident reconciliation now uses a Linux host process adapter with verified boot/start identity and pidfd signalling. Native generic process capacity and source-owned aggregate/cancellation proof are separate; this run does not resolve the original language pressure.

workaround.description: Provider-owned Linux pidfd/birth/socket platform adapter; no host assurance decisions.
